30: I could feel someone gently shaking me awake.
33: My drowsy mind snapped rapidly back to consciousness, and my vision slowly cleared.
53: "Mm, mmm... Morning, Rem... Looking cute as ever today."
60: "...Are you still half-asleep? Please hurry and get up, or we won't be ready in time."
62: Even as she brushed off my first cheesy line of the morning, she gave the hand she was softly holding a little extra squeeze.
64: She might act cool on the surface, but deep down she's definitely happy. What a sweetheart...

97: "Come to think of it, I haven't seen her at all either... I'd better go check later to make sure she didn't pass out in the Forbidden Library."
99: Wait, was she actually being considerate and giving us space in her own way? Nah, no way...
102: "Well, anyway... I guess it made for good practice for when the two of us live together someday."
109: "No, it wasn't just the two of us."
112: "Yeah, yeah, Beako was here too. I didn't forget."
119: "That's not what I mean. In the future, there will be three of us. If you forget again, even Rem will get angry."
122: "Thr―... Ah! My bad! I was totally still half-asleep... I'm seriously sorry, forgive me! I won't forget again for even a single second!"
124: Scrambling to prostrate myself right there on the bed, I apologized to the other little person resting inside Rem's belly.
131: "Yes, I'll forgive you this time. If you forget again, Rem will punish you on this child's behalf, alright?"

135: I can't keep putting it off for 'someday.' Starting today―no, right here and now―I have to be the one to protect Rem.
137: There might not be much a guy like me can do, but I've got to keep moving forward, one step at a time!
140: "Alright! I'm wide awake now! Let's give today everything we've got!"
147: "Yes. Let's keep doing our best together, from now on and always."
